I just need to say how much I actually love being a woman ✨💓⁣
⁣
It’s so easy to get caught up in the hard parts like periods, childbirth (haven’t even been there yet lol), the pressure of being the one to hold it all together sometimes, it’s so easy to complain. But when I really think about it we are just so powerful. Being a woman is actually the most divine, powerful gift. ⁣
⁣
Like, we literally shapeshift. We can become mothers. We get to create and bring actual life into this world through God’s design. That in itself makes me feel so close to something larger than myself ⁣
⁣
And the pleasure, I don’t even know how to explain it. There are things I feel in my body that I honestly don’t think men will ever understand. That kind of softness and ecstasy feels like its own type of power. 😉 ⁣
⁣
And even though I may not be “stronger” than a man, there’s such a different kind of strength in being a woman. The way beauty of a strong woman alone can draw someone in. The way our energy can shift a room. The way we carry both fire and softness at the same time. To be a balance in a man’s chaos ⁣
⁣
I just feel so grateful to be in my body that I built and nurtured in this lifetime, experiencing what it means to be WOMAN 🌸 ⁣.⁣
.⁣
.⁣
